name: Peligent AI Assistant
author: peligent

sections.description:
You didn’t build your website to spend hours editing product images, writing descriptions, and digging through logs. But that’s where most of the time goes.

Peligent brings AI directly into your WordPress admin so you can manage your website faster and focus on growing your business. It works with your existing store data to give you an AI assistant that already knows your products, orders, and customers.

AI Bots That Work For You

Set up AI bots that run on your schedule and report back with actionable insights. Whether it’s monitoring site speed, reviewing error logs, analyzing customer retention, checking plugin health, or finding growth opportunities, your bots handle it automatically.

Need something specific? Our team builds custom bots for you at no extra cost. Just tell us what you need.

Product Image Background Removal

Upload a product photo and Peligent removes the background automatically, then creates a clean, studio-style image that fits your business. No design tools needed.

AI Content Generation

Generate product descriptions, blog posts, and other content in seconds. Adjust the tone and style to match your brand, then publish directly from your dashboard.

Ask Your Website Anything

The AI chat assistant lives inside your WordPress admin. Ask about orders, customers, store performance, or anything else. It’s always one message away in the sidebar.

Conversion Analytics

Connect Google Analytics and see which products, categories, and brands convert best. Traffic, orders, and revenue in one view, synced daily so your data is always fresh.

Works in Multiple Languages

Peligent supports multiple languages, making it useful for store owners and teams around the world.

Start Free, No Payment Required

Every new account includes free AI credits to explore all features. No credit card, no trial timer. Use it, see the results, then decide.

We Build What You Need

Peligent is built for the WordPress community and shaped by your feedback. If you have an idea for a feature, a bot, or a workflow, reach out to us at support@peligent.com. We take every request seriously and regularly ship features our users ask for.

How it works

After activation, visit WooCommerce > Peligent. Paste your Peligent Connect Secret, click “Save & Connect to Peligent”, and your website is connected. The AI assistant starts learning your store right away.

External services

This plugin connects to the Peligent service at https://app.peligent.com to provide AI-powered features for your website. All communication is encrypted over HTTPS.

How the connection works

When you click “Save & Connect to Peligent”, the plugin establishes a secure connection between your website and the Peligent service. This allows the AI assistant to learn about your store and provide personalized insights, recommendations, and content.

Keeping your AI assistant up to date

Once connected, the plugin keeps the AI assistant in sync with your store so it can provide accurate, relevant responses. This includes your product catalog, order activity, and store configuration. The sync happens automatically when changes occur in your store, so your AI assistant always has the latest information.

Google Analytics and Search Console

You can optionally connect Google Analytics and Google Search Console from your Peligent dashboard to view traffic, search performance, and conversion data alongside your store metrics. These connections are read-only. Peligent cannot modify your Google data. You can disconnect at any time.

Peligent’s use of Google API data adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements. For details, see our Google API Disclosure.

Dashboard features

Several plugin pages (Bulk Update, Bots, Reports, Action History, and the AI chat sidebar) load content from app.peligent.com within your WordPress admin. These may request microphone access if you use voice input with the AI assistant.

You are in control

You can disconnect from Peligent at any time from the plugin settings page, which stops all data sharing immediately. Uninstalling the plugin removes all stored credentials and settings from your website. For Google services, you can also revoke access from your Google Account permissions.

For full details on how we handle your data, see our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Peligent.
  4. Paste your Peligent Connect Secret.
  5. Click “Save & Connect to Peligent” and follow the redirect to your Peligent dashboard.
sections.faq:
Where do I find the Peligent Connect Secret?

In your Peligent dashboard under Websites > Connect Secret.

What capabilities does the generated user have?

The plugin creates a limited user with only the specific capabilities needed to manage WooCommerce products, orders, and uploads. It does not have full administrator access. You can revoke it from the settings page at any time.

Is my data secure?

Yes. All communication between your website and Peligent is encrypted over HTTPS. We never sell your data or share it with third parties for advertising. Our servers are hosted in SOC 2 compliant data centers. See our Privacy Policy for details.

Does it work with Google Analytics and Search Console?

Yes. You can connect Google Analytics and Google Search Console from your Peligent dashboard to see traffic and search data alongside your store metrics. The connection is read-only and you can disconnect at any time.

Is there a free plan?

Yes. Every new account includes free AI credits to get started. No credit card required.

Can I request custom features?

Absolutely. Email us at support@peligent.com with your idea. We regularly build features and custom bots based on user requests.
